decisions.decision: Phase 2 parallelization: intra-file per-record rayon par_iter (not per-file); gzip decompression kept single-threaded (D-02); global record pool across files (D-03)
decisions.rationale: CRR1936095 ships as only 2 split parts — per-file would cap at ~2x; intra-file is the only path to near-core-count speedup

decisions.decision: dashmap (new dep) for the concurrent counter, preserving KmerCounter's public API (D-04/D-05)
decisions.rationale: PCOUNT-02 names dashmap; 6.x reuses hashbrown 0.14.5 (no version dup); battle-tested vs hand-rolled sharded map
New RUSTKMER_THREADS wins; RAYON_NUM_THREADS fallback preserves existing merge-tuning users

decisions.decision: --sort flipped to DEFAULT-ON (D-09, user overrode 'keep optional' recommendation)
decisions.rationale: Sharded-map iteration is non-deterministic; default-sort guarantees reproducible output and aligns with Jellyfish2 sorted output for Phase 4 fairness. Cost (sort over ~3B entries) flagged for Phase 4 measurement.

decisions.decision: Correctness via golden-capture-first + 1-vs-N commutativity differential + proptest (D-10)
decisions.rationale: Counting is integer addition (commutative+associative), so any 1-vs-N divergence is definitively a concurrency bug — high-signal detector

decisions.decision: Use pyo3 py.detach (NOT allow_threads) for GIL release
decisions.rationale: Executor source-grounded against installed pyo3 0.27.2: allow_threads is #[deprecated(since=0.26.0)] delegating to detach. RESEARCH and plan-checker had this INVERTED. detach is required to keep -D warnings green.

decisions.decision: WR-02 merge-overflow: document poisoned-but-consistent contract instead of rolling back partial mutation
decisions.rationale: Rolling back would require cloning the whole DashMap before the loop — prohibitively expensive at genome scale. Option (b) from the review fix sketch: update atomics incrementally so stats match the (partial) table, and document that the caller must discard the counter after Err.
